headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Iowa residents protest Army’s planned detonation of bomb-making chemicals
headlines.description: Iowa residents are raising concerns about the planned detonation of lead azide in Middleton, Iowa, scheduled for Friday. KWQC’s Chandler Brindley reports as residents worry that a cloud of lead dust could cause environmental contamination and health risks.

headlines.title: How to Take Care of Your Feet During the Hectic Holiday Season
headlines.description: Between traveling, icy sidewalks and hours in uncomfortable party shoes, the holidays can be hard on your feet. Podiatrist Dr. Ebonie Vincent-Sleet joins TODAY with her holiday foot health survival guide. Tips include choosing the right outdoor footwear, using compression socks, going with platforms over stilettos for party looks, elevating your feet at the end of the day and more.

headlines.title: Inside Look at Vacations Geared Toward People on GLP-1s
headlines.description: Along with focusing on diet and exercise, health and wellness resorts across the country are now catering to the millions of people using GLP-1 weight loss drugs like Ozempic, Zepbound, Wegovy and Mounjaro. The programs include cooking lessons, guided strength-training sessions, and health counseling about those weight loss medicines. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Critics blame Health Secretary RFK Jr. as U.S. loses measles elimination status
headlines.description: With over 5,000 reported cases this year and 10 deaths, the U.S. is facing a measles outbreak it hasn’t seen in decades. Politicians and public health groups are blaming Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. for the W.H.O. revoking the nation’s measles “elimination” status. NBC News’ Steven Romo has more on how the country got to this point.

headlines.title: Early Black Friday deals are here, and I’m tracking the 57+ best ones daily: Amazon, Apple, PlayStation and more
headlines.description: Early Black Friday deals are here from Amazon, Apple, Walmart, Target, PlayStation and more. Follow daily updates as our shopping experts find the best sales.

headlines.title: Talking Shop with comedian Heather McMahan
headlines.description: Comedian Heather McMahan is going on tour in 2027. She’s not traveling without her favorite packing cubes, snacks, lashes and compression socks.

headlines.title: How to find worthwhile deals during Black Friday and Cyber Monday: a step-by-step, expert-approved guide
headlines.description: Are Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals actually worth it? Shopping experts share tips on what to buy, what to skip and how to find genuine discounts.

headlines.title: Not all teeth whitening strips work the same — these 4 stood out in our testing
headlines.description: Editors tested the best teeth whitening strips of 2026, including Crest, Lumineux and Moon, to see which actually whiten teeth without sensitivity.

headlines.title: 8 Best Exercises for Gamers to Prevent Wrist, Neck Pain, According to Trainers
headlines.description: Playing the new “Grand Theft Auto?” experts recommend these streches and exercises to keep your back and neck feeling their best while you’re gaming.

headlines.title: Dietitian Shares Her Recipes for 2 Seasonal Sides Featuring High-Fiber Veggies
headlines.description: Hit your fiber goals with these dietitian-approved recipes for side dishes that feature healthy seasonal vegetables. They’re colorful, tasty and simple to make.

headlines.title: The 2 Simple Exercises a Foot Doctor Does Every Day to Ease Pain and Swelling
headlines.description: A foot and ankle surgeon reveals the two things she does to keep swollen and achy feet feeling their best. Learn how to prevent the discomfort, too.
